* Flash Flood Warning for...
East Central San Miguel County in southwestern Colorado...

heavy rain across the warned area. The expected rainfall rate is 1
to 2 inches in 1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to

properties.description:
SVRGYX

The National Weather Service in Gray Maine has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
North central Somerset County in west central Maine...

* Until 315 PM EDT.

* At 241 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 15 miles southwest
of Seboomook, or 17 miles northeast of Jackman, moving northeast at
45 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Seboomook, Rockwood Strip, Misery Gore, Sandwich Academy Grant,
Taunton And Raynham Academy Grant, Brassua, Misery, Tomhegan,
Soldiertown, Sapling, Town Of Thorndike, Long Pond, and Plymouth.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

indoors or inside a vehicle. Remember, lightning can strike out to
15 miles from the parent thunderstorm. If you can hear thunder, you
are close enough to be struck by lightning. Move to safe shelter
now!  Do not be caught on the water in a thunderstorm.
